purpose: Separate trusted observation horizon provenance from useful-work evidence endpoints so valid trailing gaps remain measurable without allowing caller-invented, author-controlled, or retroactively mutable horizons.
fail_closed: Reject promotion beyond the durable trusted horizon. Git commit timestamps cannot establish the boundary. Actions provenance MUST bind both run id and run attempt, and validation MUST fetch that immutable attempt-specific endpoint so a later re-run of the same run id cannot retroactively move the authoritative updated_at boundary.
